Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya

02-01-2026
8.
 Ct. 19 Bikash Chandra Bag & Ors.
 sg Versus
 State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Amit Pan
 Ms. Tanusri Santra
 ...for the petitioners
 Mr. Chandi Charan De, Agp
 Mr. Nikhil Kumar Gupta
 Mr. A. Mukherjee
 ...for the State

The affidavit of service filed in Court today is taken
 on record.

The petitioners claim that several plots of land within  Mouza Butia under Police Station Budgebudge in the District  of South 24 Parganas, particulars of which have been  mentioned in paragraph 2 of the writ petition, were  requisitioned vide case no. LA-II/1 of 1968-69 and the  possession of the same was also taken over.

The petitioners  allege that the aforesaid lands were sought to be acquired  upon publication of a notification under Section 4(1a) of the  West Bengal Land (Acquisition and Requisition) Act, 1948  on 19th March, 1975.

entities.text: West Bengal Land (Acquisition and Requisition) Act, 1948
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Mr. Pan, learned Counsel appearing for the  petitioners submits that no award was declared within the Sg vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 2 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134379430/
1  stipulated time limit resulting in lapsing of the entire  acquisition proceeding.
He further submits that no attempt  was made to acquire the said lands by initiating any  proceeding under Section 9(3A) of the Land Acquisition  (West Bengal Amendment) Act, 1997.

He submits that in the  meantime, the 1894 Act stood repealed and the Right to Fair  2 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 came into force with effect from 01.01.2024.

entities.text:
Right to Fair  2 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that since the properties of the petitioners have been utilized without paying any compensation, an appropriate proceeding under the 2013 Act is to be initiated.
Mr. De, learned Additional Government Pleader is also requested to appear and take instruction in this matter.

Let a report in the form of an affidavit be filed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, South 24 Parganas, being the third respondent, with regard to allegation contained in this writ petition on or before January 20, 2026 upon serving an advance copy of the said report in the form of an affidavit upon the learned Advocate-on-Record for the petitioners.
List this matter on January 21, 2026 under the heading "For Orders".

(Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, J.)
